tagline: The Aga Khan-built superyacht heartland of the Med, with the Maddalena archipelago and a short Corsica hop.
summary: Costa Smeralda (Porto Cervo) is one of the Mediterranean's most concentrated superyacht and ultra-luxury markets, gateway to the La Maddalena archipelago national park and a short hop from Bonifacio, Corsica. Olbia is the air/sea gateway. Short sheltered distances among the Maddalena islands plus an intense seasonal HNW base make this a premium Pioneer II tender-and-island-hop market.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the Costa Smeralda + Maddalena mesh (La Maddalena ~18 nm, Caprera, Spargi), the Olbia gateway link and the Bonifacio/Corsica hop (~15 nm).
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) links Sardinia to the Tuscan archipelago and mainland Italy on longer trunks.

competitive_landscape: A dense superyacht fleet, Maddalena excursion ferries and charter RIBs operate today. The intense seasonal HNW base and the park-excursion market are the openings. No foiling incumbent.
seasonality: Highly seasonal — Jun–Sep peak; the market largely empties in winter.
regulatory_note: Italian flag / EU; RINA certification; YCCS (Yacht Club Costa Smeralda) and Marina di Porto Cervo are the marina partners; La Maddalena is a protected national park with access rules.
